items.text: Repair holes in garage roof. Tarp and tie down the roof for now — the current tarp doesn't cover everything.
items.priceBasis: Est. 180 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $108. Board/patch the open holes from inside, then tarp the whole roof and tie it down. Tarp/lumber left blank: depends on how much of the roof needs covering.

items.text: Clean out garage.
items.priceBasis: Est. 120 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $72. One person bagging and hauling the garage debris out to the dumpster (dumpster is on the general clean-out line).

items.text: Close and lock the garage door.
items.priceBasis: Est. 10 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $6. Close the overhead door and lock it; add a padlock if the latch has none.

items.text: Clean up fence line.
Cut the grass.
items.priceBasis: Est. 90 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $54. Front, side and back yard, all knee-high and overgrown: weed-whack then mow.

items.text: Clean up the weeds touching the house.
items.priceBasis: Est. 30 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $18. Pull the sumac/weeds along the driveway-side wall and glass block window.

items.text: Reposition the downspout extension so it points away from the house.
items.priceBasis: Est. 10 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $6. Swing the extension out and point it away from the foundation.

items.text: Tighten up the railing — it moves easily. Make it solid and hand-graspable.
items.priceBasis: Est. 45 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $27. Re-fasten the wood front-step railing at the post and porch so it doesn't move; material $10 for screws/lags.

items.text: Clean up the weed tree touching the house.
items.priceBasis: Est. 20 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $12. Cut one weed tree at the front of the house and haul it away.

items.text: Tuck point the steps — top step.
items.priceBasis: Est. 60 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $36. Mix mortar, rake out and repoint the top step. Mostly mixing/setup time. Material $25 for a bag of mortar.

items.text: Install plexiglass in the front screen door frame.
Clean up the little weed trees touching the house.
items.priceBasis: Est. 45 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $27. Cut several small weed trees along the left side wall and haul them away.

items.text: Clean up the weed trees touching the house.
items.priceBasis: Est. 60 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $36. The rear wall is heavily overgrown with sumac and vines: cut it back and haul it away.

items.text: Scrape, skim coat, and paint the two patches in the living room ceiling.
items.priceBasis: Est. 180 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $108. Scrape the two peeling ceiling patches, skim coat (2 coats with drying time), prime and paint. Material left blank.

items.text: Install 12 blinds on the 1st floor.
Replace smoke detectors with 10-year smoke detectors.
items.priceBasis: Est. 50 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $30. About 5 detectors (3 bedrooms, hallway, basement) at ~10 min each. Material left blank: depends on count.

items.text: General cleaning — whole house.
items.priceBasis: Est. 420 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $250. Full turn cleaning of a 3-bedroom house after the clean-out: one 7-hour day.

items.text: Replace the carpet.
Clean up debris outside the house and in the garage. Also clean out living room, kitchen cabinets, basement. About 15 yard clean out.
items.priceBasis: Est. 840 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $500. 15-yard clean-out of yard, garage overflow, living room, kitchen cabinets and basement: about two person-days loading. Dumpster cost left blank.

items.text: Install missing light bulbs — 4 in the basement (incl. the closet), 2 in the bathroom, and the exterior front light fixture.
items.priceBasis: Est. 25 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $15. 7 bulbs (4 basement, 2 bathroom, front porch) at a few minutes each. Material $25 for a pack of bulbs.

items.text: Clean up all weeds and weed trees touching the house — front, left, rear, and driveway side.
items.priceBasis: Est. 0 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $0. Summary line only. The work is priced on the per-side weed lines (front, left, rear, driveway side), so labor is $0 to avoid billing it twice.

items.text: Paint bedroom.
items.priceBasis: Est. 240 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $143. Patch nail holes and roll walls in one bedroom, 2 coats. Paint left blank.

items.text: Install screens in both windows.
Tighten the door knob.
Replace the broken window glass — signs of a break-in.
Install screen.
items.priceBasis: Est. 15 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $9. Fit one screen in the broken-into window once the glass is replaced. Screen size unknown, so material left blank.

items.text: Put the closet door back on the hinges.
Paint the room — marks all over the walls.
items.priceBasis: Est. 240 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $143. Wash off marks, patch, and roll the walls in one bedroom, 2 coats. Paint left blank.

items.text: Repair the handrail going up the stairs.
items.priceBasis: Est. 45 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $27. Re-secure the loose stair handrail, replacing brackets if needed. Material left blank until we know if brackets are needed.

items.text: Install a smoke detector upstairs — there's a CO detector but no smoke detector.
items.priceBasis: Est. 10 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $6. Mount one 10-year sealed smoke detector in the upper bedroom. Material $25, matching your usual 10-year detector price.

items.text: Tighten toilet seat.
Glaze bathtub.
items.priceBasis: Est. 180 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $108. Clean/etch, mask and spray-glaze the tub. Not counting cure time. Material left blank: kit grade varies.

items.text: Repair or replace the right and left shower handles — they spin a full 360° and are likely leaking.
items.priceBasis: Est. 90 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $54. Shut off water, pull both handles, swap the stems/cartridges, reset the handle stops and test for leaks. Parts depend on the valve brand, so material is left blank.

items.text: Fix the P-trap leak — leaking from several spots.
items.priceBasis: Est. 30 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $18. Pull the leaking P-trap and fit a new one, then test. Material $25 for a P-trap kit.

items.text: Install the missing vanity door and knob.
Install a toilet paper holder — the recessed holder is empty.
items.priceBasis: Est. 20 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $12. Fit a roller in the existing recessed holder, or swap the holder. Material $10.

items.text: Paint kitchen and dining room walls.
items.priceBasis: Est. 360 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $215. Cut in around the cabinets and windows and roll both rooms, 2 coats. Paint left blank.

items.text: Remove dishwasher.
items.priceBasis: Est. 30 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $18. Cap the supply, disconnect the drain and power, pull the unit and haul it to the dumpster.

items.text: Check the water meter and its connections for a leak — water stain on the floor under the meter.
items.priceBasis: Est. 20 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $12. Dry the floor, check the meter couplings and the valve, and tighten anything that's weeping.

items.text: Install water heater at the water heater hookup.
items.priceBasis: Est. 300 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $179. Set the tank, connect water and gas, connect the vent, fill and light. The tank is left blank because its size isn't decided.

items.text: Install furnace at the furnace hookup.
Reconnect and hang the loose ductwork at the furnace hookup.
items.priceBasis: Est. 90 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $54. Lift and refasten the hanging trunk and boot sections to the plenum and re-hang them with strapping. Material left blank.

items.text: Put blank covers on the open junction boxes in the basement ceiling — loose wire splices showing.
items.priceBasis: Est. 15 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $9. Two open ceiling boxes: tuck the splices in and screw on blank covers. Material $10.

items.text: Turn the regular outlet near the laundry sink into a GFCI outlet.
items.priceBasis: Est. 20 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $12. Swap one outlet for a GFCI and test it. Material $25 for the GFCI.

items.text: Repair the damaged side door trim.
items.priceBasis: Est. 60 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $36. Pull the broken casing, cut and nail new trim, then caulk. Material left blank: depends on the trim profile.
